invariants.text: Project.project_id must be an auto-incremented integer primary key with default value None
A project's status must be updated only if the project is not marked as deleted.
A project must remain in the database when deleted, but its is_deleted field must be set to true.
Project listing operations must not return projects where is_deleted is true.
The status field of a project must be one of the valid status values defined in the system.
A project can only be deleted if it exists and is not already marked as deleted.
When a project is created, its is_deleted field must be set to false by default.
Only projects with a non-null name can be created or updated.
The project status cannot be changed to 'deleted' directly; deletion must be handled via the is_deleted field.
A project's description field may be updated or left unchanged, but must not be null during creation or update.
A project must have a unique name across all projects in the system.
